name: Adramelech
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:fist)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Thunder God's Rage", Adramelech is a gauntlet Teigu conjuring and sky-summoning electricity like lightning orbs, beams, and direct strikes by expending energy. Power scales with energy expended. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
